items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (+2.1 points per decade; 64 surveys at 29 sites, 2006–2026; q = 0.45).
Paved and roofed area went from 2.0% in 1985 to 3.0% in 2025 across 353 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

71 of 353 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 3 for salt or chloride; 97 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
4 of 353 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 19 of 19 high-need ones have none.
